headline: BNP MP's son detained over extortion allegations
summary: Khairul Islam Sajib, son of BNP MP Azharul Islam Mannan, was taken into police custody for questioning regarding extortion claims.
details: Khairul Islam Sajib, the son of BNP MP Azharul Islam Mannan (Narayanganj-3), has been taken into police custody.
He was detained from his home on Sunday afternoon by the Detective Branch (DB) of the Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP).
The detention is for questioning regarding allegations of extortion.
Following his initial arrest, Sajib was first taken to the Narayanganj Superintendent of Police office for interrogation.
He has since been moved to the DMP DB office for further questioning, as confirmed by Narayanganj DB police.
caption:
The son of a BNP Member of Parliament has been detained by police over extortion allegations.

Khairul Islam Sajib, the son of BNP MP Azharul Islam Mannan (Narayanganj-3), has been taken into police custody.

He was detained from his home on Sunday afternoon by the Detective Branch (DB) of the Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP).

The detention is for questioning regarding allegations of extortion.

Following his initial arrest, Sajib was first taken to the Narayanganj Superintendent of Police office for interrogation.

He has since been moved to the DMP DB office for further questioning, as confirmed by Narayanganj DB police.

Source: Jamuna TV, Dhaka Tribune, The Daily Star, Prothom Alo

headline: 5 men sentenced to death for kidnapping and murder of 8-year-old boy in Bogura
summary: A Bogura court has delivered a verdict on the 2018 case involving the kidnap and murder of Rifat Hossain, sentencing five adults to death and five minors to 10 years in prison.
details: A Bogura court has sentenced five men to death for the kidnapping, murder, and concealment of the body of 8-year-old Rifat Hossain in Shajahanpur Upazila.
The verdict was delivered by Md Anwarul Haque, judge of the Bogura Women and Children Repression Prevention Tribunal-1 on Sunday.
Those sentenced to death are Abul Kalam Azad, Selim Islam, Mehedi Hasan, Raju Islam, and Sagar.
Additionally, five other suspects, who were minors at the time of the crime, were sentenced to 10 years in prison.
The victim, Rifat Hossain, was the son of an expatriate, Enamul Haque. All the suspects were neighbours or acquaintances of the family.
The child went missing on July 15, 2018, and his body was recovered three days later from beneath the Bhadrabati Bridge in Poyalgachha village.
The prosecution stated that neighbour Abul Kalam Azad had repeatedly demanded money from the child's father. When the child's father refused a demand for Tk 100,000, Rifat disappeared.
The court has issued arrest warrants for the two absconding convicts and the death sentences are to be confirmed by the High Court Division.
caption:
Five men face the gallows for the 2018 kidnap and murder of an 8-year-old boy in Bogura.

A Bogura court has sentenced five men to death for the kidnapping, murder, and concealment of the body of 8-year-old Rifat Hossain in Shajahanpur Upazila.

The verdict was delivered by Md Anwarul Haque, judge of the Bogura Women and Children Repression Prevention Tribunal-1 on Sunday.

Those sentenced to death are Abul Kalam Azad, Selim Islam, Mehedi Hasan, Raju Islam, and Sagar.

Additionally, five other suspects, who were minors at the time of the crime, were sentenced to 10 years in prison.

The victim, Rifat Hossain, was the son of an expatriate, Enamul Haque. All the suspects were neighbours or acquaintances of the family.

The child went missing on July 15, 2018, and his body was recovered three days later from beneath the Bhadrabati Bridge in Poyalgachha village.

The prosecution stated that neighbour Abul Kalam Azad had repeatedly demanded money from the child's father. When the child's father refused a demand for Tk 100,000, Rifat disappeared.

The court has issued arrest warrants for the two absconding convicts and the death sentences are to be confirmed by the High Court Division.
